generated_by: the validator repository's gamma vector generator (G1). The cases are fixed literals and are not regenerated in this repository.

_notes.determinism: All inputs are fixed literals; no clock, RNG, network or chain access. Every expected byte string is computed through subnet.shared.gamma_policy / gamma_intent / gamma_funding_receipt.
_notes.addresses: Every SS58-42 address is SYNTHETIC: prefix 42 + a 32-byte public key made of a fixed repeating byte pattern (0x11/0x22/0x33/0x44), checksummed per the SS58 registry (first 2 bytes of blake2b-512(b'SS58PRE'||prefix||key)) by the dep-free encoder in subnet.shared.gamma_intent.ss58_encode_account. No real mainnet coldkey/hotkey/treasury address appears in any case. The dep-free codec is checked at generation time against the public substrate dev vector //Alice (5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY); Alice is a self-check only and appears in no case.
_notes.chain_identity: chain_id follows the mainnet convention 'bittensor-mainnet:' + 64 lowercase hex WITHOUT 0x; genesis_hash keeps the 0x form. These are public chain-identity constants, the same ones subnet.miner.funding_client.CHAIN_ID and subnet.shared.sn37_economics.GENESIS_HASH pin.
_notes.amounts: Pack/intent amounts are synthetic vector data, not shipped policy values; the wire modules contain no amounts, defaults or testnet constants.
_notes.case_shape: Each case: name, kind (policy|intent|receipt), op ('from_map' default | 'build' | 'parse_from_map'), input, languages, expect. 'parse_from_map' cases carry RAW canonical-JSON TEXT as input (duplicate keys reject at the strict parse boundary). 'build' inputs are {policy, pack_id, assigns}: the Elixir twin's equivalent construction path must refuse with the same reason.
_notes.error_kinds: expect.error is the stable machine-readable refusal kind of the typed ValueError raised by the failing language (invalid_purchase_policy | invalid_funding_intent | invalid_funding_receipt | invalid_ss58_account | retirement_before_activation | valid_from_before_issued | valid_until_before_valid_from | funding_coldkey_mismatch | authorized_spender_mismatch | gamma_api_hotkey_not_distinct | deposit_key_mismatch | purchase_policy_unselected | pack_id_invalid | pack_unknown | pack_amount_mismatch, plus canonicalization kinds such as duplicate_key).
_notes.conventions: Identifier fields are nonempty within their stated charset/length bounds; retirement_block is optional by ABSENCE ONLY (explicit null rejects); finalized_block_number is an unbounded int (bool excluded) exactly as the G1 field spec states; deposit_key reuses the deployed U+2016 (‖) join.
